weather_report:
As the sun makes its genteel descent over Boston, the afternoon presents a pristine canvas of mostly sunny skies. The air is crisp, whispering hints of autumn, inviting you to savor the moment. Clarity reigns with a gentle northeastern breeze that adds a refreshing touch to the day's ambiance. Temperatures gracefully hover around a mild 59 degrees, letting a light layer or a soft cardigan be your ally if you venture outside. 

As twilight approaches, the heavens will don a partly cloudy demeanor, ushering in a cozy evening that settles around 41 degrees. With such pleasant weather, a leisurely stroll through the city or perhaps a meandering visit to one of Boston’s charming cafe-lined streets would be just the ticket. A light jacket paired with comfortable shoes will serve you well, allowing you to revel in the crispness of the air as you watch the city shift into evening. In this serene calm, taking time to appreciate the beauty of autumnal leaves dancing in soft breezes adds a touch of joy to your day.
